title: web/src/audio/link-clock.ts: WebSocket client, ping offset filter, server time to AudioContext frames
description:
## Intent
`web/src/audio/link-clock.ts`: turn the server's clock into clock lines in `AudioContext` frames. Makes the offset and loss scenarios of apricitus-0afc13 green.

## Steps
1. Read `custom.apricity.link.url` from the loaded outputs (where `web/src/data` reads `custom.apricity.mode`); no Link when absent.
2. WebSocket client with reconnect and backoff; ping at the rate from `design/link.md`; offset from the lowest-round-trip pings in a window; pings slower than the threshold ignored.
3. Map server micros to `performance.now()` and then to `AudioContext` frames with `getOutputTimestamp()` and `outputLatency`; produce a clock line for the worklet.
4. Pure functions for the math and filter, unit-tested without a browser; states: off, connecting, linked, lost.

## Verify
`cd web && npx tsx --test test/link-clock.test.ts` and `npm --prefix web run build` (types).

Commit: `feat(<this task id>): link clock in the page`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
